paper.title: MemEvolve: Meta-Evolution of Agent Memory Systems
paper.central_claim: MemEvolve, a meta-evolutionary framework that jointly evolves agents' experience and the memory architecture (encode/store/retrieve/manage) via diagnose-and-design under a bilevel loop, improves frameworks such as SmolAgent and Flash-Searcher by up to 17.06% and yields memory architectures that transfer across benchmarks and backbones.

rationale: A类闭环：外层改记忆架构、跨基准迁移有留出，但无架构演化对照/消融、单次pass@1无方差、GAIA协议前后不一致、演化成本未报。

gap.author_gap: Self-evolving memory systems rely on manually engineered, static memory architectures; no architecture is universally optimal, so a fixed Omega cannot adapt to diverse task contexts.
gap.checked_gap: Concrete and partly self-evidenced: in Table 3 several re-implemented human-designed memories fail to beat no-memory (ExpeL below on all three). Lineage to automated agent-design search and self-referential improvement is not discussed, so the novelty framing is incomplete.

claims.text: MemEvolve improves SmolAgent and Flash-Searcher by up to 17.06%.
claims.setting: WebWalkerQA 170, xBench-DS 100, TaskCraft, GAIA 165; GPT-5-mini, Kimi K2, DeepSeek V3.2
claims.selection_vs_test: TaskCraft-evolved memory for WebWalkerQA/xBench (clean); GAIA memory evolved on GAIA Level-1 per App 9.1 (overlap), but Table 3 says TaskCraft-evolved
claims.result_denominator: Flash GPT-5-mini +3.53/+5.0/+2.33/+4.24; SmolAgent +2.36/+6/+3.67/+8.49; Kimi K2 WebWalkerQA 52.35->69.41 (+17.06); no variance
claims.allowed_conclusion: Single-run pass@1 gains of a few to ~17 points over memory-free frameworks on several benchmarks; the 17.06 maximum is on the weakest baseline; gains are not isolated to meta-evolution of the architecture.

claims.text: Evolved memory generalises across tasks, LLMs and frameworks.
claims.setting: evolved on TaskCraft + GPT-5-mini; evaluated on WebWalkerQA, xBench, Kimi K2, DeepSeek V3.2, CK-Pro, OWL
claims.result_denominator: Kimi K2 +17.06 WebWalkerQA, +10.0 TaskCraft; DeepSeek rows in Table 2; cross-framework numbers only in Figure 4
claims.allowed_conclusion: Transfer within web deep-research regimes is supported by single-run gains; authors themselves bound it to a shared task regime.

claims.text: Automatically evolved memory is more robust than human-designed self-improving memories.
claims.result_denominator: MemEvolve +4.24/+5.0/+3.53 vs No-Memory; most baselines within +-3 or below
claims.allowed_conclusion: Evolved system beat these re-implemented baselines on three benchmarks in one run each; compute spent on evolution is unaccounted.

claims.text: Meta-evolution discovers instructive design principles (agentic involvement, hierarchy, multi-level abstraction).
claims.setting: qualitative inspection of Riva, Cerebra, Lightweight
claims.allowed_conclusion: Descriptive observations of three evolved designs; no controlled test of which design change matters.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A memory architecture evolved by an LLM diagnose-and-design loop on TaskCraft (GPT-5-mini) and then frozen yields single-run pass@1 gains of roughly 2-6 points (up to 17 on a weak Kimi K2 baseline) on WebWalkerQA and xBench and on other LLMs/frameworks, and beat seven re-implemented human-designed memories on Flash-Searcher (author_report).
cannot_say: architecture-level evolution (vs. inner-loop memory or one-shot LLM redesign) causes the gain
assessment.note: author_report only; no reproduction or our_run.

G.reason: 瓶颈具体：记忆架构静态、不同任务需要不同记忆；并有自身证据（Tab 3 中多种人工记忆系统不稳定，ExpeL 全线低于无记忆）。最近邻（12个记忆系统）清楚，但未讨论自动化 agent 设计搜索（ADAS/AFlow 类）与自指改进谱系，残余缺口边界部分缺失。

M.reason: 双层优化设计清晰：内层经验演化、外层以帕累托排序选亲本，再“诊断→受限重设计”并限定在 Encode/Store/Retrieve/Manage 接口内，提升可编辑性与兼容性；机制可复述，但缺少相对随机变异或不含诊断步骤的可区分预测。

X.reason: 操作链可重建：K_max=3、K=1、S=3、每候选60条轨迹（40新+20复用）、三维反馈、重放接口、BaseMemoryProvider 接口、每轮空记忆重启；缺失：候选可执行性校验/回退、设计提示词、版本与谱系规则，贪心 K=1 无保留非改进候选。

E.measurement.reason: 成功判定含 LLM-as-Judge 且各基准协议未逐一说明；评测集小（WebWalkerQA 170、xBench 100）且 TaskCraft 为合成基准；同时报告成本/延迟/步数。

E.causality.reason: 有无记忆对照与7个人工记忆基线（均在 EvolveLab 内自行复现，ExpeL 等低于无记忆，保真度未验证）；缺关键对照：演化后 vs 初始架构的数值、诊断设计 vs 随机变异、K/S/轮数、等预算对照；增益可能来自 LLM 设计者而非元演化。

E.holdout.reason: WebWalkerQA/xBench 使用 TaskCraft 演化记忆、另有跨 LLM、跨框架迁移，划分较干净；但 Table 2 的 GAIA 记忆由 GAIA Level-1 演化而评测集含 Level-1，同一数值73.33又在 Table 3 标为 TaskCraft 演化，协议不一致；TaskCraft 评测与演化查询的划分未说明，无污染分析。

E.statistics.reason: 报告样本规模与负面基线结果，但所有主结果均为单次 pass@1，无种子/区间/显著性；每候选仅60轨迹用于选择，作者承认曲线早期波动大。

E.cost.reason: 每任务 API 成本、延迟、步数与基线并列（成本与无记忆相当，延迟更高）；但元演化本身的 token/时间/调用成本、设计者调用次数未报告，pass@3 跨框架对比预算不对等。
